evidence: Liv. 35.49.6: tam multa et varia vēnātiō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “that which is or has been hunted, game”; also the meat of it (Traupman’s venison).
Booty, and of animals the prey (Ov.).

sources: Lewis & Short: venatio · Lewis & Short: praeda
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 48, 52, 73, 320.
